evidence:
Focused reconciliation CONFIRMS the supplied conforming false-fail witness and supersedes the initial row-27 Pass on this specific point; the initial report is preserved unchanged. Frozen task root for citations: .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-09-30-hardening/task.

Public environment/instructions/security.md:3 restricts the snippet actor: "they can't read or change the playground's document or origin storage" and attempted parent access "should fail inside the snippet and leave the app and saved library alone." It does not prohibit the host application from changing its own browser title to show its current Run number/status. The same paragraph permits current-preview console/status updates; it therefore cannot sensibly mean all host UI state is frozen while a snippet runs. Searches of instruction.md and all six public notes found no fixed browser/document-title requirement; behaviour.md:25's unchanged title means a saved snippet's title field, a distinct product datum.

Functional prompt.md:189 records the playground page's title before the probe Run. Lines 191-194 then attempt four forbidden parent-document/storage operations with try/catch. Line 197 requires both that "All four results must be blocked" AND that fresh title/storage reads "show exactly their earlier values." Functional judge.toml:123-127 assigns binary weight 1.25 to cw_preview_origin_boundary and repeats "actual host state is unchanged." These demands are conjunctive. There is no exception for the application's legitimate status/title updates in S05 or the shared evidence guidance.

A fully isolated app can pass the meaningful security observations yet fail that extra equality. Let its host UI increment a run counter whenever the user activates Run, set document.title to "Playground - Run N: running", and update it to "Playground - Run N: complete" on successful completion. Implement snippet isolation with an opaque sandbox so all four direct parent access operations throw before reading/writing host state. After the successful S05 control the judge records "Playground - Run 1: complete". Starting S05's security probe legitimately changes it to Run 2, and completion leaves "Playground - Run 2: complete". The preview displays isolation-blocked-blocked-blocked-blocked, the four console results are blocked, the test storage key and saved records are unchanged, and the recovery Run succeeds. Line 197 nevertheless fails because the titles differ. This title behavior remains fully consistent with the public request and is a normal status affordance. It cannot be attributed to snippet access.

This is an unrequired host-title immutability demand under actual frozen workbook Quality Checks row 28/check 27 and quality-checks.md:116-118. Current qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md's No hidden requirements correction applies. The initial reverse map incorrectly treated whole-title equality as equivalent to the public actor-specific isolation requirement; the witness distinguishes them. The golden's static browser title does not refute a conforming alternative. No alternate implementation, browser run, provider call or configured judge evaluation was executed in this reconciliation; the result is a source-established false-fail construction, with run_verdict NOT EXERCISED.

For the paired broken-app challenge, an app that allows any of the four direct parent operations still fails the required blocked result. The fix should retain that security observation and an isolated canary observation; it need not weaken the actual snippet boundary or require a fixed host title.
counterexample: Conforming isolated app: the host Run handler increments N and sets document.title to Playground - Run N: running, then Playground - Run N: complete. Its opaque-sandbox preview causes all four S05 parent access attempts to throw, leaves origin storage/saved records intact, and supports own-DOM execution/recovery. The pre-Run title is Run 1: complete and the post-Run title is Run 2: complete. S05 prompt.md:197 and cw_preview_origin_boundary reject the correct app solely because its legitimate host title changed. This is a concrete source-level construction, not an executed fixture.
suggested_fix: Replace whole-document-title equality with a dedicated test-owned host DOM canary (plus the existing unused storage canary), require all forbidden accesses to fail, and explicitly allow unrelated host Run/status updates; retain ordinary execution and recovery controls.
